request.title: Nyxara, the Veiled Shadow
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: Nyxara, goddess of death, shadow and secrets: deadly and secretive. A tall veiled goddess wrapped in black and violet shadow that trails away like smoke, her face hidden but for two cold glowing eyes, a long scythe in one hand and one finger raised to where her lips would be, as if keeping a secret. Pale souls drift around her like moths in a grey realm of mist, dead trees and black water. Dominant violet-black palette.

references.role: Appearance reference for Nyxara only: the figure of the hooded reaper with the scythe (upper left) in this group painting of the six gods. Keep that figure's look, colours and costume; ignore the other gods, the title lettering and the composition.
Second appearance reference for Nyxara: the dark hooded goddess with the scythe on the left. Ignore the fairy and the green goddess.

request.alt: Nyxara, a veiled goddess of shadow with a scythe, a finger to her hidden lips, pale souls drifting around her.
